to_five: a1 (4): When a land touches /.hsreview-protected paths, hs land should land the unprotected files and turn the protected ones into a proposal to the required reviewers in one step (e.g. hs land --split-review). Missing-block errors should retry or wait for the hub instead of failing immediately, and should agree with hs doctor.

a2 (2): hs should fetch the missing main-view blocks from the connected hub automatically on any command (hs fetch with progress and a timeout as the fallback), and hs doctor should flag it, so a connected hub never leaves the worktree unusable.

a3 (2): hs land should fetch missing index blocks from the hub itself (retry until timeout) instead of failing, and an approval event should only print 'approved' when the current revision actually counts it (show 'approved rev 0, rev 1 needs re-approval' otherwise)
